title: Stadium with a long span steel roof, Brisbane: painting
workplace: Stadium with three grandstands, concourses, corporate boxes and a long span steel roof, Brisbane
note: Facts are example inputs for testing. On a real project they come from the contractor's own procedures and the project's documents.

swms.title: Concourse painting
swms.task: Paint the concourse walls and ceilings with water-based paint from scissor lifts more than 2 m above the floor.

facts.safetyDataSheet: Safety data sheets for the water-based paints are kept at the work area: avoid skin contact, wear gloves and eye protection.
facts.fallControl: Scissor lifts with guardrails are used for all work above 2 m, and platform ladders only for work below 2 m.
facts.controlsConsidered: Edge protection was considered for every task, and an elevating work platform where edge protection cannot be fixed.
